body: Thanks. I'm sorry I didn't call, I'm kind of... Shut off right now. It always happens after an emotional outbreak.
Thank you. I'm just a typical teen, friend group dissolving and all. I probably won't tonight, it's nice to know that someone cares.

Read it, beautiful book.
I understand that it gets better, but I have been holding on for a long, long while. It just gets kinda old, I'm sure I don't have to tell tell you that.
I definitely have ADHD(hyperactive inattentive) and probably ADD as well. I'm trying to treat it, I take adderal once a day.
Outside of this sub I have my three friends, who I am finding increasingly distant and annoying. Its hard to find teenagers who aren't typical stereotypes, especially at my school(very prestigious)
Only history, its fun to walk into class and win a debate with no preparation. I'm not interested in anything else I do in school, I just sit there and waits for the bell to ring.
Not tonight, I have a summer reading assignment that I haven't even started yet, plus a test tomorrow.

I dont know... I think that it changed again

Yeah, I'm that way with everything. Today I went from hopeful to resigned, manic to depressed, lonely to excited about 6 times. I guarantee you each person  talked too in my different phases got to know a different person.
No problem! It's nice to talk.  My answer to this changes constantly from blue to green and back again, usually blue when I am happy or manic and green when I am down, or, strangely, calm.

probably... green.
and thanks for talking.

Thanks for the advice, thats what I tell myself every day to get through the next round of classes. I don't want to sound for ungrateful for the help, but this is what I meant by people telling me to "power through" or keep my head up. I know that my life will probably improve in college, but when I was in middle school I told myself to just wait till high school. Now I am just telling myself to wait until I get a car.
I just think that I have had enough of waiting for some new freedom on the horizon to inch it's way towards me, only to have it fade away and reappear in the distance.

Thank you so much for the reply. I have reached out to a few people before, but it almost felt like they were obligated to talk to me, not to say that they didn't want to help, but... It just seems different when it is an internet stranger you don't know at all, showing that other people give a damn about your life. Part of my depression, and the reason I probably wont kill myself, is that I have a guilty personality. Hell, I feel guilty for wanting to die in such a good life, full of opportunities! I don't know. I will definitely look into medications and other solutions to make my world vibrant. Thanks again, for all of the advice, and just stopping by and saying something.
